newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Minor SAfrica parties may get cabinet posts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Minor SAfrica parties may get cabinet posts - paper.

text.p: South Africa's President Nelson Mandela is considering offering cabinet positions to certain minor parties, including Democratic Party (DP) leader Tony Leon, the Business Day newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The paper said Mandela was considering a larger role for minority parties, including the DP and the Pan Africanist Congress (PAC), ahead of the February 7 opening of parliament.
Officials declined to comment on the speculation.

The paper said Mandela appeared to be concerned that an emerging agreement between his ruling African National Congress (ANC) and the PAC could create a situation in which the opposition parties -- the DP and the National Party -- were essentially white, while the governing parties -- the ANC, PAC and Inkatha Freedom Party -- were black.
